#--Figure 5A--

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyquant)
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(rprojroot)
library(wesanderson)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

virome_met_dt <- merge(virome_dt, meta_dt, by = "sample_ID")
virome_met_dt$Date <- as.Date(virome_met_dt$Date, format = "%d-%m-%Y")

virome_met_dt$species <- gsub("^s__", "", virome_met_dt$species)
heatp <- virome_met_dt %>%
  filter(Name %in% c(
    "Influenza A virus (A/Bewick swan/Netherlands/1/2014(H12N1))",
    "Influenza A virus (A/chicken/Rostock/45/1934(H7N1))",
    "Influenza A virus (H1N1)",
    "Influenza A virus (H3N2)",
    "Influenza A virus H3N8",
    "Influenza A virus H5N1",
    "Influenza A virus H9N2",
    "Human respiratory syncytial virus A",
    "Rhinovirus A",
    "human metapneumovirus",
    "Human coronavirus 229E",
    "Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2",
    "Human respirovirus 3",
    "Human respirovirus 1",
    "Human adenovirus 12",
    "Human adenovirus 18",
    "Human adenovirus 31",
    "Human adenovirus 21",
    "Human mastadenovirus B"
  )) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Month = floor_date(Date, "month"),
    Name = case_when(
      Name == "Influenza A virus (A/Bewick swan/Netherlands/1/2014(H12N1))" ~ "IAV H12N1 (Swan)",
      Name == "Influenza A virus (A/chicken/Rostock/45/1934(H7N1))"         ~ "IAV H7N1 (Chicken)",
      Name == "Influenza A virus (H1N1)"                                     ~ "IAV H1N1",
      Name == "Influenza A virus (H3N2)"                                     ~ "IAV H3N2",
      Name == "Influenza A virus H3N8"                                       ~ "IAV H3N8",
      Name == "Influenza A virus H5N1"                                       ~ "IAV H5N1",
      Name == "Influenza A virus H9N2"                                       ~ "IAV H9N2",
      Name == "Human respiratory syncytial virus A"                          ~ "RSV-A",
      Name == "Rhinovirus A"                                                 ~ "Rhinovirus A",
      Name == "human metapneumovirus"                                        ~ "hMPV",
      Name == "Human coronavirus 229E"                                       ~ "HCoV-229E",
      Name == "Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2"              ~ "SARS-CoV-2",
      Name == "Human respirovirus 3"                                         ~ "PIV-3",
      Name == "Human respirovirus 1"                                         ~ "PIV-1",
      Name == "Human adenovirus 12"                                          ~ "HAdV-12",
      Name == "Human adenovirus 18"                                          ~ "HAdV-18",
      Name == "Human adenovirus 31"                                          ~ "HAdV-31",
      Name == "Human adenovirus 21"                                          ~ "HAdV-21",
      Name == "Human mastadenovirus B"                                       ~ "HAdV-B",
      TRUE ~ Name
    ),
    
    virus_group = case_when(
      grepl("IAV", Name)          ~ "1_Influenza A",
      grepl("HCoV|SARS", Name)    ~ "2_Coronavirus",
      grepl("RSV|hMPV|PIV", Name) ~ "3_Paramyxo/Pneumo",
      grepl("Rhinovirus", Name)   ~ "4_Picornavirus",
      grepl("HAdV", Name)         ~ "5_Adenovirus",
      TRUE                        ~ "6_Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  group_by(Month, Airport, Name, virus_group) %>%
  summarise(RPKMF = sum(RPKMF), .groups = "drop") %>%
  
  complete(Month, Airport, Name, fill = list(RPKMF = 0)) %>%
  
  group_by(Month, Airport) %>%
  filter(any(RPKMF > 0)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
mutate(
  log_val = log10(RPKMF + 1),
  
  Name = factor(Name, levels = c(
    "IAV H1N1", "IAV H3N2", "IAV H3N8", "IAV H5N1",
    "IAV H9N2", "IAV H7N1 (Chicken)", "IAV H12N1 (Swan)",
    "SARS-CoV-2", "HCoV-229E",
    "RSV-A", "hMPV", "PIV-1", "PIV-3",
    "Rhinovirus A",
    "HAdV-12", "HAdV-18", "HAdV-21", "HAdV-31", "HAdV-B"
  ))
) %>%
  
ggplot(aes(x = Month, y = Name, fill = log_val)) +
  
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  
  geom_tile(data = . %>% filter(log_val == 0),
            fill = "#FFFFFF", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours  = c("#f7f7f7", "#3e387a", "#8b3a8f", "#fe715e"),
    values   = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.3, 0.65, 1)),
    na.value = "#FFFFFF",
    name     = "log10(RPKMF + 1)",
    limits   = c(0, NA),
    guide = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth       = 10,
      barheight      = 0.6,
      ticks          = TRUE,
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust    = 0.5,
      direction      = "horizontal"
    )
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(7.5, 9.5, 13.5, 14.5),
             color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  
  facet_wrap(vars(Airport), nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b-%y",
    expand      = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, colour = "black", size = 10),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(colour = "black", size = 11, face = "italic"),
    strip.text       = element_text(colour = "black", size = 13, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#e8e8e8", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin      = margin(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, "cm"),
    panel.spacing    = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )

heatp

#--Figure 5B--


pA <- iav_airport %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(total_reads = sum(read_count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(real_data = TRUE) %>%   # 👈 mark real data
  
  complete(Date = seq(as.Date("2024-07-01"), 
                      as.Date("2025-08-01"), 
                      by = "month"),
           fill = list(total_reads = 0, real_data = FALSE)) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = Date)) +
  
  geom_col(aes(y = total_reads + 1), fill = "grey85", width = 25) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = ~subset(.x, real_data == TRUE),
    aes(y = total_reads + 1),
    color = "#08519c",
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  
  geom_smooth(
    data = ~subset(.x, real_data == TRUE),
    aes(y = total_reads + 1),
    method = "loess",
    se = FALSE,
    color = "#cb181d",
    linewidth = 1.2,
    span = 0.6
  ) +
  
  scale_y_log10() +
  
  scale_x_date(
    limits = c(as.Date("2024-07-01"), as.Date("2025-08-31")),
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b-%y"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Sampling Month",
    y = "Total Influenza Reads (log10 scale)"
  ) +
  
  pub_theme

pA

#--Figure 5C--


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

df <- iav_airport %>%
  mutate(read_assignment = ifelse(is.na(read_assignment), "ambiguous", read_assignment)) %>%
  group_by(Date, Airport, read_assignment) %>%
  summarise(read_count = sum(read_count), .groups = "drop")

df$read_assignment <- factor(
  df$read_assignment,
  levels = c("H1N1","H3N2","H5N1","H7N1","H9N2","ambiguous")
)

serotype_colors <- c(
  "H1N1" = "#2a9d8f",
  "H3N2" = "#e76f51",
  "H5N1" = "#6a4c93",
  "H7N1" = "#e9c46a",
  "H9N2" = "#8ac926",
  "ambiguous" = "grey75"
)

pub_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey70"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "cm"),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  )

pB_raw <- df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = read_count + 1, fill = read_assignment)) +
  
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 25),
    width = 15,
    alpha = 0.85,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~Airport, nrow = 1) +
  
  scale_y_log10() +
  
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b-%y"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = serotype_colors,
    breaks = levels(df$read_assignment),
    drop = TRUE
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Read Count (log10 scale)",
    fill = "Serotype"
  ) +
  
  pub_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

pB_rel <- df %>%
  group_by(Date, Airport) %>%
  mutate(rel_ab = read_count / sum(read_count)) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = rel_ab, fill = read_assignment)) +
  
  geom_col(position = "fill", alpha = 0.9) +
  
  facet_wrap(~Airport, nrow = 1) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b-%y"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = serotype_colors,
    breaks = levels(df$read_assignment),
    drop = TRUE
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Sampling Month",
    y = "Relative Abundance (%)",
    fill = "Serotype"
  ) +
  
  pub_theme

final_plot <- (pB_raw / pB_rel) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )

final_plot
